title: Quantize, dither, compand, and write a WAV file
brief: Quantize to N bits and measure the 6.02N + 1.76 dB rule, add TPDF dither, build 8-bit mu-law, and write and read 16-bit WAV files with struct.
hints: A 3-bit step is 2 ** (1 - 3) = 0.25, so 0.9 / 0.25 = 3.6 rounds to 4, which clips to the top code 3, giving 0.75.
10 * np.log10(1.5 * 4.0 ** bits) is exactly the full-scale prediction; 6.02 N + 1.76 is its rounded form.
np.log1p(mu * np.abs(x)) is ln(1 + mu |x|), and it stays accurate for tiny x.
struct.pack('<HHIIHH', 1, channels, rate, rate * 2 * channels, 2 * channels, 16) is the whole 16-byte fmt body.
An int16 array shaped (frames, channels) is already in interleaved order: pcm.astype('<i2').tobytes() writes L0 R0 L1 R1 and so on.
When walking chunks, advance by 8 + size, plus 1 more when size is odd.
